notes: Adds the hot-reload-safe weapon runtime observer and integrates it into the ADK DEV LOADER.

Observes combat turns, active-turn movement, canonical firearm use, attack and damage rolls, HP damage and zero-HP transitions, native ammunition updates, capacity-related Item updates, native rests, equipped firearms, and FEHA Bonus Action flags.
Exposes diagnostics and disabled future-feature switches at game.adk.weaponRuntime.
No manufacturer passive, armor enforcement, consumable runtime, roll, Actor, Item, Token, or Combat mutation is introduced by this observer build.
